pillars.title: A Quiet Building on Central Alberta Farmland
pillars.body: The centre is a large, hotel-style building on open farmland just north of Tees, east of Lacombe. Participants have 27 single rooms with their own bathrooms, and detox happens in five rooms kept apart from the rest of the residence. Days are spent in classroom sessions and groups, with shared meals in between. For downtime there is a workout room with Peloton bikes, a reading library, an art room, a pool table, ping pong and foosball, a volleyball net and an outdoor fire pit, plus yoga on Thursday nights.

pillars.title: 4, 8 or 12 Weeks with Psychiatric Support
pillars.body: The addiction treatment program at iRecover Alberta is world-class, offering a range of services to meet the unique needs of each participant. The program includes 4, 8, and 12-week treatment programs, one-on-one counseling, and group counseling. Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is also available during weeks 5-8 of the program. Participants have access to psychiatric assessment and treatment from Dr. Avi Aulakh, a renowned addictions expert.

pillars.title: Lifetime Aftercare and the iRecover Alumni Group
pillars.body: iRecover Alberta’s treatment program also includes fitness and nutrition programs, family support during visiting days, private single rooms with en-suite bathrooms, and group outings and recreational activities. The center provides transportation to and from outside meetings, and participants are given a computer tablet pre-loaded with the full program content, enabling them with ongoing access to the four live 12-step meetings per day following their treatment. The center’s Lifetime Aftercare Program and membership in the iRecover Alumni Group provide ongoing support and accountability for participants after they complete their treatment.

location.heading: iRecover Alberta in Tees, Alberta
location.intro: iRecover Alberta is on farmland just north of the hamlet of Tees in central Alberta, about 25 minutes east of Lacombe and a little under half an hour from Ponoka. Edmonton is roughly an hour and a half away by car, Red Deer about 45 minutes and Calgary about two hours, and staff can arrange a pick-up from the Red Arrow bus terminal in Red Deer.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing, its own website and its recovery.com profile. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does iRecover Alberta cost?
faqs.a: The 4-week residential program costs $17,000 plus tax and the 8-week program costs $28,000 plus tax, according to the centre's claimed recovery.com profile. Medically supervised detox is $5,200, and aftercare is included once you finish. The centre bills weekly, so if you leave early you pay only for the time you used. Confirm current prices when you call.

faqs.q: What type of treatment does iRecover Alberta offer?
faqs.a: iRecover Alberta specializes in the treatment of substance abuse disorders and offers a range of evidence-based therapies and services to meet the unique needs of each participant. Their treatment programs include medically supervised detoxification, psychiatric assessment and treatment, one-on-one counseling, group counseling, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), fitness and nutrition programs, family support, private single rooms, and group outings and recreational activities.

faqs.q: Does iRecover Alberta offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Detox is the first step for most people and takes place in five detox rooms kept separate from the main residence, with medical staff on site around the clock. It usually lasts between 24 hours and a week, depending on the person and the substance.

faqs.q: How long are the treatment programs at iRecover Alberta?
faqs.a: iRecover Alberta offers 4, 8, and 12-week treatment programs to meet the unique needs and challenges of each participant.

faqs.q: Is a doctor referral needed to access iRecover Alberta's services?
faqs.a: No, there is no wait list or doctor referral needed to access iRecover Alberta’s services. The only requirement for admission is the desire to change one’s life.

faqs.q: Where is iRecover Alberta and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 41003 Range Road 235A, just north of Tees in central Alberta. It is about 25 minutes from Lacombe, 45 minutes from Red Deer, an hour and a half from Edmonton and two hours from Calgary. Staff can pick you up at the Red Arrow bus terminal in Red Deer, and the closest airports are Edmonton, Calgary and Red Deer.

faqs.q: Is iRecover Alberta private? Can I use benefits or financing?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a private, fee-based centre. It takes Visa and Mastercard and offers financing through Medicard, Paybright and Bright Futures Financial. It says some extended health plans, trade unions, employer EAPs, First Nations bands and Veterans Affairs Canada may pay for part or all of a stay, so check with your plan before you book.

faqs.q: What type of aftercare does iRecover Alberta offer?
faqs.a: iRecover Alberta’s Lifetime Aftercare Program and membership in the iRecover Alumni Group provide ongoing support and accountability for participants after they complete their treatment.

faqs.q: Is iRecover Alberta accredited and licensed?
faqs.a: Yes. CARF lists the centre as Serenity Ranch dba iRecover Alberta, with a three-year accreditation for adult residential addiction treatment, first granted in 2011. The centre's website also shows its Residential Addiction Treatment Services licence from the Province of Alberta.

faqs.q: Are the treatment programs at iRecover Alberta individualized?
faqs.a: Yes, iRecover Alberta’s treatment programs are designed to address the unique needs and challenges of each participant, providing them with individualized care and support.

faqs.q: Are the rehab centers at iRecover Alberta co-ed?
faqs.a: Yes, the rehab centers at iRecover Alberta are co-ed.

faqs.q: Are the treatment programs at iRecover Alberta evidence-based?
faqs.a: Yes, iRecover Alberta’s treatment programs are evidence-based and incorporate a range of therapies and services that have been proven effective in the treatment of substance abuse disorders.

faqs.q: How does iRecover Alberta ensure privacy for its participants?
faqs.a: iRecover Alberta’s private single rooms with en-suite bathrooms provide participants with a safe and private space for rest and reflection. Additionally, the center’s policies and procedures prioritize the privacy and confidentiality of all participants.
